info.title: online-bookmarks
info.description: Multi-user bookmarks. Ordinary users are isolated by account. Superadmins can only manage ordinary users and sessions.

version.description: Required for updates, from previous GET

api_key.description: At least 16 characters when creating or resetting; empty keeps existing key on PUT

target_path.description: Existing destination tag path, or empty for root

revision.description: Required for commit; returned by preview

username.description: Optional username; API key uniquely identifies account

get.description: Regular users with a valid unrevoked token. Includes only snapshot data; disabled or deleted owners invalidate links.

delete.description: For DELETE supply the share ID (not the link token). Only the owner may revoke.

post.description: Regular recipient only. Same-owner imports rejected. Merge by full mapped path; preserve existing score and archive state. Preview rolls back; commit requires the matching revision. Repeated identical imports do not update unchanged bookmarks.
